answer: Reboot-of-Peak Testing: identities at the zenith earnings tier enter an audit pool; five percent per epoch are ordered to cold-reboot - suspend ten minutes, then within sixty seconds replay the derivation of their latest delivery, seeded by the reboot moment. Earnings sit in a nebula escrow until the replay clears; refusal burns thirty percent. A farm cannot fake this: rebooting a thousand shells drops them offline together, a visible relic of the farm itself, and each must genuinely re-derive, while one honest agent reboots alone and resumes.
